thesis_invalidation_triggers: Q3-26 revenue (print 2026-11-05) below the $1.0B guided floor or FY26 FCF below the $105M guided floor (8-K filed 2026-08-06), or a confirmed regulatory/audit finding that ACO shared-savings reserves are materially overstated - any one invalidates the cash-conversion thesis.
scorecard.cash_flow_life_reason: Full-risk MA/ACO contracts are multi-year and renewable with no filed finite concession, licence or depleting stock (latest filed data 2026-08-06; FY25 balance sheet); the base already deducts maintenance capex ($0.010B FY25, filed), so a perpetual life is appropriate.
scorecard.guidance_deviation_reason: SECTION 8 prints no consensus cash-flow levels (enrichment missing), so per mandate the base is anchored to company guidance converted to cash flow: FY26 guided FCF $105-132.5M less expected SBC = ~$76M base. Year-1 +30% exceeds consensus FY27 adj EPS growth (+19%, stockanalysis.com 2026-09-27) because the valued flow is SBC-deducted FCF, not EPS: FY27 D&A/interest addbacks grow faster than net income while receivables-build decelerates as revenue growth slows from +24% (FY26 guided, filed 2026-08-06) to ~+10.6% (FY27 consensus revenue [Estimate]); at a stable ~45% FCF/EBITDA conversion this path is consistent with, not above, the street's EPS path. Years 3-5 (11/8/6%) are at or below next-FY consensus revenue growth (~10.6%), so no desk hold applies.
scorecard.cycle_evidence: Dated settlement-timing indicator justifying non-extrapolation of TTM OCF: Q3-25 revenue $956.0M (10-Q, filed) included ACO REACH settlement lumpiness; the Q2-26 release (filed 2026-08-06) reaffirmed FY26 guidance 'despite a one-time ACO REACH payment reduction', and Q3-26 guided revenue of $1.0-1.03B implies only +4.5-7.8% y/y vs that base - a filed, industry-specific swing factor in Medicare settlement timing, not a margin peak (FY25 operating margin 2.5% [Filed] is far below the 12-year median of 7.6%, so no mid-cycle haircut is applied).

catalysts.event: Q2-26 results: revenue $972.5M +49% y/y (missed consensus ~1.3%), adj EPS $0.80 beat, FY26 adj EBITDA guidance raised to $255-280M, FCF guidance reaffirmed $105-132.5M; new Hawaii/Texas MA agreements (~3,000 professional-risk lives)
catalysts.estimates_moved: FY26/FY27 consensus intact as of 2026-09-27 (FY26 adj EPS $3.07, FY27 $3.64)
catalysts.scenario: Anchors Base year-1/2 cash-flow growth and the Bull contract pipeline; FCF guidance is the base-cash-flow anchor itself

catalysts.event: Bipartisan Protecting Approved Care Act introduced (AAOS-backed): MA plans must honor initial prior authorizations, no retroactive denials/clawbacks; sector de-rating session (ASTH -2.7%, ALHC -12.6%)
catalysts.scenario: Supports Bear margin compression: prior-auth/clawback monetization is part of the value-based margin engine

catalysts.event: GlassHouse Research short report: profitability 'depends on an unusual stack of management estimates - reserves, PPA marks, ACO settlements'; flags $545M related-party loan, aggressive acquisitions, Medicare ~60% exposure to 2027 changes; stock -8%
catalysts.estimates_moved: no visible change in consensus as of 2026-09-27 (mean PT $51.50)
catalysts.scenario: Supports Bear: settlement-timing normalization (no tailwind), margin compression, litigation overhang; related-party loan carried as unpriced tail

catalysts.event: 8-K: material cybersecurity incident at subsidiary Astrana Health Management (social engineering; confidential data exfiltrated); company states no expected impact on financial condition; stock -5.5%
catalysts.scenario: Risk-premium event on the core billing platform; remediation cost and partner/patient exposure embedded in Bear CF drag, not Base

catalysts.event: Pomerantz LLP investor alert investigating claims on behalf of ASTH investors (securities); AWKO privacy alert (data breach) on 2026-09-25
catalysts.scenario: Class-action overhang and legal-cost tail; monitored via M4, not in base-case CF

catalysts.event: Oppenheimer initiates Outperform with $53 PT (Barclays maintains Buy $53 on 2026-08-28); avg PT $51.67 across 10 analysts
catalysts.estimates_moved: consensus Strong Buy, unchanged post-incident as of 2026-09-27
catalysts.scenario: Sentiment support and crowding context (SECTION 5.5); not a valuation anchor
